journey.name: onchain original payment cancel
journey.description: Verifies the exits from an unresolved original software on-chain payment once its request, quote or order can no longer be re-authorized. Precondition: an onboarded funded dev wallet, PIN enabled, a synced node, and a retained unresolved prepared-send receipt for a Paykit request or Blocktank order whose candidate never reached the chain, with its exact original recipient, amount, inputs and candidate transaction IDs. Creating that fixture needs a controlled refusal, which the Capabilities table does not provide; a seeded Pending fixture must be labelled as state injection, never as proof of a native fault. Mining the 6 confirmations needs a regtest miner, so the unlock steps are Manual Tests. Manual Tests must also confirm against the backend that the cancellation spends the original inputs and pays only this wallet, that a cancellation evicted from mempools can be replaced at a higher fee over the same inputs, that Retry without checking is refused once the order or request is already marked as paid, and that a late payment is accepted by the payee before shipping Retry without checking. See prepared-fee-recovery.md in this directory for the shared fee-recovery cases. iOS adaptations: Pending keeps its existing copy, which says not to start a separate payment rather than that other payments remain blocked. The Retry without checking warning and its fee entry share one alert, so Cancel on that alert closes both. The prepared fee and any fee warnings appear in alerts whose confirm button is Authorize cancellation, and custom fees use getFeeLimits() (at most 999). Recovery failures, including the earlier cancellation still pending, appear as an error toast over Pending, as Retry original payment's do. A cancellation refused after one whose outcome was unknown also reports that one as still pending, because it may have been relayed. While Retry original payment, Cancel payment or Speed up cancellation is offered, the buttons take the hourglass's place. When the request's own state cannot be read, for example without a Pubky identity, Pending still offers Cancel payment but neither retry; manually verify that case with the Pubky profile signed out. Transfers to spending are no longer sold, so for a Blocktank order Retry original payment opens Transfer Unavailable and Retry without checking is not offered: run the retry steps with a Paykit request fixture, and with an order fixture verify only that Pending offers Cancel payment and that it follows the same cancellation steps.

actions.action: Open the retained original payment's Pending screen and record its displayed transaction ID
Verify Pending says other payments remain blocked and offers Retry original payment, Cancel payment and Retry without checking

Tap Retry without checking and verify a warning says the request, quote or order may have expired, the recipient may not accept a late payment, and Bitkit will not send it if it is already marked as paid
Tap Cancel on the warning and verify the original Pending payment remains retained
Verify the dialog shows the original recipient and amount, explains the cancellation needs 6 confirmations, and prefills a fee rate above the original
Enter a valid fee rate that the funded fixture can support and tap Continue

Verify the exact prepared mining fee in sats is shown without a recipient amount; tap Authorize cancellation, accept any normal fee warnings, and verify the normal payment PIN screen appears before dispatch
Enter the fixture's normal payment PIN without recording entered digits

Verify Pending shows Cancellation sent with its transaction ID, says the payment can be cancelled again if the cancellation drops out of the network without confirming, no longer offers Retry original payment or Retry without checking, and still offers Cancel payment
Wait for the wallet to sync, then verify Pending offers Speed up cancellation instead of Cancel payment
Tap Speed up cancellation, verify the dialog prefills a fee rate above the cancellation just sent and at least the normal fee rate, tap Continue, and complete the normal payment PIN screen
Verify Pending shows Cancellation sent with a new cancellation transaction ID and still offers Speed up cancellation
Close the sheet, start a new on-chain send, and verify it is refused back to the original Pending payment
After the cancellation has 6 confirmations and the wallet syncs, verify a Payment Cancelled toast appears and a new on-chain send reaches its confirmation screen
